title: The Halloween Pumpkin
cn: 第 6 集 · 万圣节的南瓜姑娘
novel:
Every year on Halloween, Ted climbed to the roof and waited.

Four years earlier, at a noisy [[costume|costume]] party, he had met a girl [[dressed as|dress as]] a pumpkin. They talked for an hour about films and cheap wine. Then she [[vanished|vanish]] into the crowd before he could ask for her number.

Since then she had become a [[legend|legend]] — his own tiny [[myth|myth]].

So he put on the same silly [[outfit|outfit]] again: a green [[hat|hat]], plastic [[fangs|fangs]], and a [[cape|cape]] that made him look [[absurd|absurd]]. Barney called it [[pathetic|pathetic]]. Lily called it [[loyal|loyal]]. Both were right.

The roof was freezing. Ted [[shivered|shiver]] under the [[chilly|chilly]] wind while children below shouted for sweets and [[carved|carve]] pumpkins [[glowed|glow]] orange on every step.

Hour after hour he stayed, [[stubbornly|stubbornly]] [[scanning|scan]] the street. His fingers went [[numb|numb]]. His hope [[shrank|shrink]].

She never came.

When the last light went out, Ted went downstairs. He was [[disappointed|disappointed]], but not sad. Some people, he decided, are not a [[destination|destination]]; they are just proof that the [[search|search]] is worth it.

Next year, he would climb up again.

costume.en: special clothes you wear to look like someone or something else

dress as.en: to wear clothes that make you look like someone or something

legend.en: an old story, or a famous person people talk about

myth.en: a very old story, or an idea that many people believe but is not true

outfit.en: a set of clothes worn together

hat.en: something you wear on your head

fangs.en: long sharp teeth, like a snake or a vampire has

cape.en: a loose coat with no arms that hangs from your shoulders

absurd.en: very silly and against common sense

pathetic.en: so weak or sad that people look down on you

loyal.en: always supporting a person or an idea

shiver.en: to shake because you are cold or afraid

carve.en: to cut a shape into wood, stone or a pumpkin

glow.en: to give out a soft, warm light

stubbornly.en: in a way that refuses to stop or change

scan.en: to look carefully across a place to find something

numb.en: unable to feel anything, often because of cold

disappointed.en: sad because something did not happen as you hoped

destination.en: the place you are travelling to

search.en: the act of trying to find something
